name: query_pdb
description: Search the Protein Data Bank for experimental 3D protein structures (X-ray, cryo-EM). Returns PDB IDs, resolution, experimental method, and download URLs.

parameters.query: string — gene name, protein name, or PDB ID (e.g. 'TP53', '4HFZ')
parameters.query_type: string — 'gene' (search by gene) or 'pdb_id' (fetch by PDB ID)

returns: dict with structures list: pdb_id, title, resolution, method, download_pdb URL
